Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: Misinterpretation of thermochemistry and heat-flow signs: freezing of exterior droplets indicates the reaction inside absorbs heat from surroundings (endothermic), not releases it. The Planner incorrectly concluded exothermic and also mismapped the option letter (stating “Exothermic because energy is released” as B instead of D), and prematurely marked the task complete without systematic validation.
